question.text: SEBI's 'Simplified Disclosure Document' (Sep 09, 2025 circular) for PMS aims to:

answer.text: Standardise and simplify PMS disclosure for ease of investor understanding

explanation.text: The Logic: Sep 2025 circular: standardised template, plain language, highlighting fees/risks — to make PMS DD comparable across managers. The Trap: The DD isn't replaced, just simplified. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-A Topic 8 depth; XXI-B applies. Manager's Pro-Tip: Move from legacy 50-page DDs to the simplified format — SEBI has deadlines for conversion.
